title: A student budget in four steps
caption: Start with income, track spending, set realistic limits, and review the plan as your month changes.
imageAlt: Four connected steps lead from income to a reviewed budget.

title: Needs and wants
caption: Needs support health, safety, or study. Wants can add enjoyment when essentials are covered.
imageAlt: Two balanced shapes represent essential needs and optional wants.

title: Plan a month of spending
caption: List regular costs first, then plan flexible expenses and goals with what remains.
imageAlt: A monthly calendar beside a simple planned-spending list.

title: Make a savings goal
caption: Choose a target, decide on a regular contribution, and check progress along the way.
imageAlt: A savings jar and rising progress marks illustrate a savings goal.

title: Small costs add up
caption: Recording small purchases helps reveal patterns and make a more realistic plan.
imageAlt: Coins beside a spending list illustrate how small purchases add up.

title: Review and adjust
caption: A budget is a guide. Review it when your income, expenses, or priorities change.
imageAlt: A checklist and circular arrow represent a regular budget review.

title: The 50-30-20 guideline
caption: As a starting point, consider 50% for needs, 30% for wants, and 20% for savings. Adjust the guideline to fit your circumstances.
imageAlt: A segmented circle shows a sample budget split of 50 percent needs, 30 percent wants, and 20 percent savings.

title: Try a small savings challenge
caption: Choose a comfortable amount to set aside each week, track each contribution, and celebrate steady progress.
imageAlt: A short checklist tracks weekly deposits toward a savings challenge.
